Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: finished 2D painted terrain background for a playable Godot strategy game, NOT a screenshot.
Edit the supplied reference. Preserve its specific smooth painterly textures, restrained green grass, warm sandy straight road, matte rocky outcrops, tree shapes and compact Sengoku fortification. Keep EXACTLY the same battlefield composition in the portion between its top status bar and bottom unit-card dock.
Remove ALL interface at top and bottom, all text and parchment word sign, ALL soldiers including archers on the decks, ALL healthbars, circles, placement rings, cursors and selection markers. Do not leave silhouettes or ghost artifacts. Reconstruct clean grass/road under the removed actors. KEEP the blue flags, fortress buildings/palisade/gate lower-left and the TWO empty raised wooden shooting decks with stone foundations and stairs at upper-middle and lower-right. Those are actual game scenery.
Output ONLY the clean playfield cropped edge-to-edge to its terrain, wide landscape 2048x960 aspect approximately 2.13:1. No black bars or interface space. Road centerline stays straight from just right of lower-left fortress gate around normalized(.25,.77) to upper-right beyond screen (1.05,-.04). Empty upper deck center around(.445,.265), lower deck around(.640,.735). The blue-gray river follows upper-left boundary, few irregular trees and rock groups in same positions; large clear green areas and wide unobstructed battle lane. Match reference faithfully rather than redesigning. Fixed orthographic elevated quarter view, sunlight upper-left, softly painted detailed natural surfaces, no glossy 3D or pixel art. Absolutely no people, UI, words, numbers, watermark, circles or healthbars.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent RGBA 2D strategy-game character animation atlas, not a reference board.
Reference is the desired game's smooth painted Sengoku battlefield. Make soldiers that fit it, but correct overly short limbs: natural sturdy 5–5.5-head human proportions, visibly longer forearms and lower legs, feet and hands anatomically readable; NOT chibi, dwarf, baby or stumpy.
EXACT atlas layout 4 columns x4 rows, square canvas2048x2048, equal invisible512px cells. Every sprite wholly inside its cell; transparent background, no ground shadow, labels, guides, UI, watermark or scenery.
Rows top-bottom:1 YARI SPEARMAN light ordinary infantry navy long-sleeved tunic, simple black chestplate, navy jingasa, shin wraps/strawsandals, exactlyone straight long spear NO crossblade.2 ARCHER navy armored archer holding asymmetrical Japanese yumi and quiver, no spear/gun.3 MATCHLOCK GUNNER navy armor jingasa shouldered tanegashima, no cannon.4 SAMURAI dark navy lamellar cuirass kabuto and single katana, no exaggerated ornaments.
Columns left-right exactly: NE(rear-right facing upper-right) walking leftlegforward; NE same soldier rightlegforward; SW(front-left facing lower-left) walking leftlegforward; SW same rightlegforward. Genuine differing opposing stride poses eachpair with SAME face/outfit/scale/lighting and stable hat/pelvis positions. All rowcharacterssameanatomicalbodyheightabout330px fromhattofeet, identicalfootbaseliney440ineachcell; spearorbowcanextendupbutstaysinsidecell. Rearviewchesthidden,frontviewchestvisible; no mirroredfakeback.
Fixed elevated orthographic quarterview about44degrees down, see hat/shoulder tops. Beautiful smooth matte hand-painted tactical sprite, thin restrained dark outlines, upper-left daylight, muted indigo blue cloth, nearblack metal, tan skin, no gloss, pixelart or 3Dplastic. Fullbody, onepersonpercell, no weapons or limbs sticking between cells. Clear silhouettes at gamebodyheight44px. 16 unique painted sprites total. Output only realalpha atlas.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep the exact same character, horse, direction and painterly look in the input. SINGLE transparent game sprite ONLY, not a sheet. Create one production-ready transparent PNG sprite of a small enemy Sengoku wooden watchtower / firing platform for a fixed-camera 2D quarter-view strategy game. Match the reference battlefield's smooth hand-painted realistic textures, muted grassy earth colors, readable timber edges, calm low-contrast lighting. Camera is fixed elevated approximately44degrees, orthographic quarter view, see roof/upper deck and south-west-facing front side. A modest timber platform on short thick wooden legs, rough low palisade railing, narrow steps facing bottom-left, small muted brick-red vertical banner. No soldier, no text, no UI, no glow, no cast floor shadow, no scene/background. Should feel grounded, built of timber, not cartoon plastic, not giant fortress. Sprite about as tall as two infantry bodies, enough transparent padding and clear bottom contact; single asset centered. Alpha transparent background.

mechanicalProcessing: Registration/cropping of atlas source regions and uniform 0.5008 scale normalization of mounted SW alternate only. No drawn replacement parts, recoloring or per-frame stretch.
limitations: Existing NE/SW two-frame walk poses remain. Separate four-direction archer/spear idle and attack assets for both factions are recorded in action-generation-provenance.json. Other roles still need authored actions; no full eight-direction set. One playable painted base map; story assigns the scenario automatically with no combat-mode selector.
